//Tenant: Single-tenant fallback (ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT=false): tenant id for control-plane lookups (persona baselines). Ignored in multi-tenant mode, where Tenants[] below is the registry.
//ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT: AD-05 deployment flag. true → resolve tenant per request from the subdomain ({slug}.<host>) and bind the tenant_{slug} schema (AD-07/API-02). Hit e.g. https://acme.localhost:PORT and https://globex.localhost:PORT. Set false to revert to single-tenant (plain localhost).
//Tenants: Subdomain→tenant registry (config stand-in for the M-11 control-plane `tenants` table). Key = slug = tenant_{slug} schema. The dev bootstrapper provisions a schema per entry; the dev seeder seeds each.
//MfaEncryptionKey: On-prem (ENABLE_MULTI_TENANT=false) AES-256 key for MFA-secret envelope encryption. Fixed dev key so the E2E seeder and the running host encrypt/decrypt with the same key. NEVER use this value outside Development.
